z-m-01-07.title: Kana uchiwedzera, inogara iri yakawanda kupfuura pakutanga here?
z-m-01-07.goal: Dzidza kuti kuti utonge chirevo unoda ruzivo rwe 'zvakawedzerwa zvingani', gadzira counterexample nekuwedzera 0, uye ugadzirise chirevo pamwe chete nemamiriro aro.
z-m-01-07.material: Pane marubles 5 mubhokisi remarubles. Jian akati, "Kana ukaisa marubles mazhinji mubhokisi remarubles, pane marubles mazhinji kupfuura pakutanga nguva dzose!" (Marubles haabviswi mubhokisi; anongoiswa chete.)
z-m-01-07.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuverenga nekuunganidza nhamba dzinosvika pa10, nekuziva kuti 0 zvinoreva 'hapana zvachose'
z-m-01-07.s.s1.prompt: Jian akati, 'Kana ukaisa marubles mazhinji mubhokisi remarubles, pane marubles mazhinji kupfuura pakutanga nguva dzose.' Chii chimwe chaunoda kuziva kuti uone kana izvi zvakarurama?
z-m-01-07.s.s1.hint.0: Nemarubles 5 mubhokisi, fungidzira nyaya yekuisa rubble 1 nenyaya yekuisa marubles 3.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja nhamba yemarubles anoiswa nenzira dzakasiyana uye uwane nhamba dzipi dzinoita kuti chirevo chisaruramise.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kunokahadzika kana zvichigona kuenderana nenhamba yakaiswa.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.b: Ruvara harina chekuita nekuva nemarubles akawanda kana mashoma. Unofanira kutsvaga ruzivo rwunobatana nenhamba yemarubles.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana bhokisi rakakura kana rakadiki, nhamba yemarubles mukati inogona kuverengwa wega. Ruzivo rusingaenderani nekuti pane akawanda here.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.explain: Mashoko e 'isa mamwe' haataure kuti mangani anoiswa. Unoda kuziva nhamba yakawedzerwa kuti utonge kana pane akawanda kupfuura pakutanga.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nhamba yekutanga yemarubles nenhamba yemarubles anoiswa, uye ugadzire nyaya 2, ane nhamba dzekutanga dzakasiyana, umo pasina marubles akawanda kupfuura pakutanga. (Marubles ekutanga ari 1 kana kupfuura uye 20 kana pasi.)
z-m-01-07.s.s2.hint.0: Chinja nhamba yemarubles anoiswa, uye unyore kana pane akawanda kupfuura pakutanga.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti nhamba ipi yakaiswa inosiya marubles ari mubhokisi asina kuchinja.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Marubles ekutanga ari 1 kana kupfuura uye 20 kana pasi.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Nyora marubles ekutanga senhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa20.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Nhamba yemarubles anoiswa i0 kana kupfuura.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Nyora nhamba yemarubles anoiswa senhamba yechisikigo i0 kana kupfuura.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Hapana marubles akawanda kupfuura pakutanga. Chirevo chaJian chaputsika.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Pane marubles akawanda kupfuura pakutanga. Sarudza zvakare nhamba yakaiswa.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.explain: Kana marubles 0 aiswa, marubles anoramba sezvaiita. Zvakafanana chero nhamba yekutanga ichiva yei. Saka chirevo che 'kana ukaisa mamwe, inogara iri yakawanda' chinoda mamiriro e 'kana ukaisa kunyange 1'.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare chirevo chaJian zvakarurama. Chinyore kuti chiratidze riini marubles akawanda kupfuura pakutanga uye riini asina.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.hint.0: Mumienzaniso yawakagadzira pamusoro, mangani akaiswa? Taura kuti chii chakaitika kumarubles ipapo.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.hint.1: Isa nyaya yekuisa rubble 1 nenyaya yekuisa 0 padivi nedivi uye unyore mutsara mumwe.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Chirevo changu chakagadziriswa chinotsanangura zvose nyaya yekuisa 0 neyekuisa 1 kana kupfuura here?
z-m-01-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Chinotaura chinhu chimwe chete chero nhamba yekutanga yemarubles ichiva yei here?
z-m-01-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakachinyora nemamiriro panzvimbo pe 'nguva dzose' here?
z-m-01-07.s.s3.model.0: Kana ukaisa 1 kana kupfuura, pane akawanda kupfuura pakutanga. Asi kana ukaisa 0, inoramba yakafanana.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.model.1: Kana usina kuisa chinhu, hazvikure uye zvinoramba zvakafanana nekutanga. Kana ukaisa kunyange rimwe, zvinoita zvakawanda.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inotaura zvinoreva zvimwe chete pasina izwi re '0'.

z-m-01-03.title: Kuchinja nhevedzano kunopa kukosha kumwe chete here?

z-m-01-03.material: Seoyun aitaura nezvemachipisi akati, 'Kana ukaverenga nenhamba mbiri, unowana kukosha kumwe chete kunyange ukachinja nhevedzano.' Ngatitarisei ruzivo rumwe panguva imwe uye tifunge kuti chirevo chaSeoyun chakarurama kusvika papi. Machipisi haagoni kuparadzaniswa kana kugadzirwa kubva pasina, uye haugoni kudya akawanda kupfuura aunayo.
z-m-01-03.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa mhando yokutonga kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya
z-m-01-03.thinking.2: Kutarisa kana kuverenga kuchigoneka mushure mokuchinja nhevedzano

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Batanidza hwendefa rine machipisi 3 nehwendefa rine machipisi 5. 3 ne 5 pamwe chete zvinoita 8. Kana ukachinja nhevedzano ukabatanidza 5 ne 3, ndi 8 zvakare. Seoyun akati, 'Kana ukaverenga nenhamba mbiri, unowana kukosha kumwe chete kunyange ukachinja nhevedzano.'

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoparadzanisa nyaya yatakaona (kubatanidza) nenyaya dzatisati taona.

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kutonga uku kunongwarira nokuti mienzaniso mishoma. Ipfungwa yokutarisa nemienzaniso yakawanda.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Tenda kuti inogara iri yakarurama kukuverenga kwose kwenhamba mbiri
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Izvi zvakawedzera mienzaniso yokubatanidza kukuverenga kwose. Hatisati taona kuverenga kunobvisa kana kutsvaga zvasara.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Takaona mienzaniso yakawanda yokubatanidza. 4 ne 6 zvinoita 10, uye 6 ne 4 zvinoitawo 10. 0 ne 7 zvinoita 7, uye 7 ne 0 zvinoitawo 7. Panguva ino, funga nezvokudya 4 pamachipisi 9. Machipisi 5 anosara. Kana ukachinja nhevedzano, 'kudya 9 kubva pamachipisi 4' hakugoni kuitwa, saka kuverenga uku kwaizoda kuverenga kwatisati tadzidza.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvichibva pazvawaona nyowani, unofungei pamusoro pechirevo chaSeoyun?
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Mienzaniso yokubatanidza yakaramba ichirurama, uye nyaya umo nhevedzano isingagoni kuchinjwa yakaonekwa munyaya yokudya chete. Kutonga kunofunga zvakasiyana pamhando umo chirevo chakarurama kunowirirana zvakanaka.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kana uchibatanidza chakarurama, asi kana uchidya pane nguva dzausingafaniri kuchinja nhevedzano
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Yakaparadzanisa nyaya yokubatanidza nenyaya yokudya uye yakaderedza mhando umo chirevo chakarurama.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kunyange kubatanidza kana kudya, kukosha kunogara kwakafanana kana ukachinja nhevedzano

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Muenzaniso wokudya hauputsi nyaya yokubatanidza. Mapeya ose matatu emienzaniso yokubatanidza aiva nokukosha kwakafanana.

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuderedza mhando se a, kana kuparadzanisa nyaya se d, inzira yakarurama yokugadzirisa chirevo chaSeoyun.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kana ukabatanidza nhamba mbiri, unowana kukosha kumwe chete kunyange ukachinja nhevedzano
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uyu chirevo chakaderedzwa kunyaya umo chirevo chakarurama (kubatanidza).

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kana ukanyora nhamba huru kutanga, pane nyaya umo kuverenga kwakachinjwa kusingagoni kuitwa zvachose. Iyo nyaya yakasiyana nokuti kuchinja nhevedzano kunopa kukosha kumwe chete here.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kana uchisanganisa zvakafanana, asi kana uchidya pane nguva dzaunofanira kusachinja kurongeka

z-m-01-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza a ne b, verenga mashoko ega ega ekuverenga kuviri uchitaura, uye uongorore kana imwe neimwe inogona kuitwa.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti kuverenga kupi kusingagoni kuitwa kana a yakakura kupfuura b nekana a iri pasi pe b.

z-m-01-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Unogona kudya b kubva ku a.

z-m-01-01.title: Nzira dzokugovera mabhulu 9 pakati pemasaga maviri
z-m-01-01.goal: Ratidza nokuzvigadzira iwe pachako kuti pane nzira dzakawanda dzokuparadzanisa 9 kuva nhamba mbiri, uye utsanangure kuti ungaverenga sei pasina kushaya.
z-m-01-01.material: Pane mabhulu 9. Unoda kuaisa ose mumasaga maviri, saga dzvuku nesaga bhuruu, pasina chinosara. Saga rega rega rinowana bhulu 1 kana kupfuura. Masaga maviri ane ruvara rwakasiyana, saka unogona kuaparadzanisa. Mina akati, 'Pane nzira imwe chete yokuparadzanisa mabhulu 9 pakati pemasaga maviri.'
z-m-01-01.thinking.2: Kutsanangura nzira yokuverenga pasina kushaya kana kudzokorora
z-m-01-01.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwokuparadzanisa nokubatanidza nhamba kusvika pa 10 (nhanho yeGiredhi 1)
z-m-01-01.s.s1.prompt: Nzira yakanaka yokuziva kana Mina akarurama ndeipi?
z-m-01-01.s.s1.hint.0: Taura kuti mabhulu mangani anosara esaga bhuruu kana ukaisa bhulu 1 musaga dzvuku.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja nhamba iri musaga dzvuku kuva 2, wobva 3, uye utarise zvinoitika kunhamba inosara.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.r.a: Zvatoitwa kuti pane mabhulu 9. Zvaunoda kuziva ndezvokuti pane nzira dzingani dzokuaparadzanisa.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.o.b: Pane masaga maviri, saka ndinofunga kuti pane nzira imwe chete zvakare.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.r.b: Kufunga uku kwakatora huwandu hwemasaga nehuwandu hwenzira dzokuparadzanisa sezvakafanana. Hakuna kutarisa zvinoitika kana nhamba yakaiswa ichichinja.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.o.c: Chinja huwandu hwemabhulu akaiswa musaga dzvuku.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.r.c: Uku ndiko kufunga kwokuyedza zvakananga kana paine dzimwe nyaya nokuchinja nzira yokuparadzanisa.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.explain: Chirevo chokuti 'nzira imwe chete' chinoputsika pakarepo kana kunyange imwe nzira yamuka. Yedza kana kuchinja nhamba iri musaga dzvuku kunochinjawo nhamba inosara yesaga bhuruu.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Paradzanisa mabhulu ose 9 kuti saga dzvuku rive nemabhulu akawanda kupfuura saga bhuruu. Gadzira nzira 3 dzakasiyana. Saga rega rega rinowana bhulu 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba yesaga dzvuku, wobva waverenga kuti mangani anosara esaga bhuruu.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza nhamba uchienzanisa kana nhamba yesaga dzvuku iri huru kupfuura nhamba yesaga bhuruu.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Masaga ose mbiri ane 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwemabhulu inhamba yechisikigo, 1 kana kupfuura. Isa bhulu 1 kana kupfuura musaga rega rega.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Mabhulu emasaga maviri anofanira kuwedzera kuita 9.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Saga dzvuku rinofanira kuva nemabhulu akawanda kupfuura saga bhuruu.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.explain: Kuisa 5, 6, 7, kana 8 emabhulu musaga dzvuku, nzira dzose 4 dzinogoneka. Kana nhamba iri musaga dzvuku yasarudzwa, nhamba iri musaga bhuruu yasarudzwawo, saka nhamba yakasiyana musaga dzvuku inoreva nzira yakasiyana.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukaparadzanisa masaga neruvara, pane nzira dzingani zvose dzokuparadzanisa mabhulu 9 pakati pemasaga maviri? Nyorawo kuti wakaverenga sei pasina kushaya kana kudzokorora.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba iri musaga dzvuku. Wobva wava ne mangani anosara esaga bhuruu?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga ne 1 musaga dzvuku uye uwedzere rimwe panguva imwe, uchinyora patafura kana semitsara yenhamba, uye utarise kuti wasvika kumagumo.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Huwandu hwenzira dzandakaverenga hwakafanana nehuwandu hwenzira dzandakanyora here?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti hauna kuverenga nzira imwe chete kaviri kana kushaya?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakacherechedza here kuti mhinduro inochinja zvichienderana nokuti unoparadzanisa masaga neruvara kana kwete?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.model.0: Ndakaisa mabhulu 1, 2, 3, ... 8 musaga dzvuku nenhevedzano uye ndikanyora zvakasara kusaga bhuruu. Ndi 1+8, 2+7, ... 8+1, saka pane nzira 8 zvose. Kana ruvara rwakasiyana, 5+4 ne 4+5 nzira dzakasiyana.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.model.1: Kana ndikawedzera nhamba iri musaga dzvuku rimwe panguva imwe, 1, 2, 3, ... 8, saga bhuruu rinosara ne 8, 7, ... 1. 5+4 ne 4+5 nzira dzakasiyanawo nokuti ruvara rwakasiyana, saka pane nzira 8 zvose.

z-m-01-06.title: Mutsara mumwe wenhamba unogona kukodzera nyaya dzakawanda here?
z-m-01-06.goal: Dzidza kuti mutsara mumwe wenhamba unogona kuoneka munyaya dzakasiyana (zvasara, musiyano), uye gadzira iwe amene nyaya inokodzera mutsara wenhamba wakapiwa.
z-m-01-06.material: Mutsara wenhamba 12-5 haufanire kuratidzwa nenyaya imwe chete. Tarisa kuti 12 ne5 zvinoreva chii munyaya imwe neimwe uye zvainoda kuwana, uye usarudze nyaya dzinokodzera mutsara wenhamba. Zvinhu hazvipatsanurwi kana kuitwa pasina chinhu.
z-m-01-06.thinking.1: Kuwana nyaya dzakawanda dzinoratidza mutsara wenhamba mumwe chete
z-m-01-06.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuverenga nhamba dzinosvika pa20 nekuverenga nyaya dzekuwedzera nekubvisa
z-m-01-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nyaya dzose dzinokodzera mutsara wenhamba 12-5. (12-5 inoverengwa 'twelve minus five'.)
z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kunyaya imwe neimwe, nyora kuti 12 ne5 zvinoreva chii imwe neimwe.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana zvinoda kuwana nyaya imwe neimwe i 'nhamba yakakura kupfuura 12' kana 'nhamba iri pasi pe12'.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.a: Mwana aiva nemapenzura 12 ndokutenga mamwe 5 kushopu yezvinyorwa. Pane mapenzura mangani pamwe chete?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakabatanidza nyaya inokura nemutsara wenhamba 12-5. Nyora zvakare mutsara wenhamba unokodzera nyaya.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.b: Mabharuni 5 pa12 akaputika. Mabharuni mangani asara?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvakabatanidza nyaya umo 5 dzinobviswa kubva pa12 nemutsara wenhamba.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.c: Mushure mekudya maapuro 5, 7 akasara paplate. Maapuro aiva mangani pakutanga?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.c: Mutsara wenhamba haisi 12-5 asi '□-5=7'. Nyaya inobvunza nhamba yekutanga inoratidzwa nemutsara wenhamba wakasiyana.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.d: Pane marubles matsvuku 12 nemarubles ebhuruu 5. Marubles matsvuku akawanda sei?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakadzidza kuti nyaya inoenzanisa nhamba mbiri kuwana musiyano inogonawo kuratidzwa ne12-5.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.explain: Nyaya yemabharuni inobvunza nhamba yakasara mushure mekuti 5 dzabva pa12, uye nyaya yemarubles inobvunza musiyano pakati pe12 ne5. Zvose zvinogona kuratidzwa ne12-5. Nyaya yemapenzura i12+5, uye nyaya yemaapuro i□-5=7.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira iwe amene nyaya inokodzera mutsara wenhamba 9+6. Inyore kuti iratidze kuti 9 ne6 zvii munyaya uye zvainobvunza. ('9+6' inoverengwa 'nine plus six'.)
z-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti 9 ne6 imwe neimwe inoverenga chii.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira mamiriro umo nhamba mbiri dzinosanganiswa, uye unyore chinhu chaunoda kubvunza mumamiriro iwayo semubvunzo mumwe.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Zvakajeka here kuti 9 ne6 zvinoreva chii munyaya yangu?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mhinduro yemubvunzo inhamba yaunowana ne9+6 here?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Inyaya inoita kuti shamwari ifunge 9+6 kana ichiiverenga here?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.model.0: Pakanga paine maapuro 9 mubhasiketi uye Amai vakaisa mamwe 6. Pane maapuro mangani pamwe chete?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.model.1: Pakanga paine vana 9 paplayground uye vamwe 6 vakauya. Pane vana vangani paplayground zvino?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inoita mamiriro ekusanganisa kuita nyaya inokura. Nyaya inosanganisa mapoka maviri akasiyana inonakawo.

z-m-01-08.title: Nhamba inoenda mu □: tingaivimba sei?
z-m-01-08.goal: Dzidza kuti makosha e □ akawanikwa nenzira dzakasiyana anogona kuongororwa nemwero mumwe chete, kuisa nhamba yawakawana, wobva wawana kugadzirisa kwakaitwa zvisirizvo uye utaurire shamwari kuti ungaongorora sei.
z-m-01-08.material: Mumutsara wenhamba □+6=14, □ 'inhamba inopa 14 kana ukawedzera 6'. Dohyeon akaiwana nekuedza nhamba mu □ imwe panguva, uye Sea akaiwana nekuverenga shure nhanho 6 kubva pa14. Gaon akagadzirisa nenzira yakasiyana. ('□+6=14' inoverengwa 'box plus six is fourteen'.)
z-m-01-08.thinking.0: Kuongorora nzira dzakasiyana nemwero mumwe chete
z-m-01-08.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuwana huwandu hwenhamba dzinosvika pa20 nekuwana nhamba inopa nhamba yakati kana yawedzerwa
z-m-01-08.s.s1.prompt: Mu □+6=14, Dohyeon akaedza 7, 9, ne8 mu □ nenzira ndokuwana 8. Sea akaverenga shure nhanho 6 kubva pa14 ndokuwana 8. Chii chakarurama pamusoro penzira mbiri?
z-m-01-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ongorora kana nhamba dzakawanikwa nevaviri dzakafanana.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.hint.1: Isa nhamba yawakawana, 8, mu □, verenga 8+6, uye uone kana ichipa 14.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.a: Nzira yaDohyeon yekuedza nhamba zvakananga chete ndiyo inogona kuvimbwa
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.a: Pfungwa iyi inovimba nenzira yekuedza nhamba zvakananga chete. Nzira yaSea yakapawo nhamba imwe chete, uye unogona kuiongorora nekuiisa.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.b: Nzira yaSea yekuverenga shure chete ndiyo yakarurama
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.b: Pfungwa iyi inogamuchira nzira yekuverenga shure chete. Nzira yaDohyeon yakaongororwawo nekuiisa mu □.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.c: Kune zvose, unogona kuongorora nekuisa 8 mu □
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti nzira dzose mbiri dzinogona kuongororwa nemwero mumwe chete (kana kuiisa mu □ kunopa 14).
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.d: Nzira yaSea, yakaiwana nekukurumidza, ndiyo nzira yakarurama.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.d: Kuiwana nekukurumidza hakuna chekuita nekururama. Mwero ndewekuti nhamba yawakawana inopa 14 kana yaiswa mu □.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.explain: Kuedza nhamba nekuverenga shure nzira dzakasiyana, asi dzakawana nhamba imwe chete, 8. Nzira ipi neipi yaunoshandisa, unogona kuvimba nenhamba kana ukaiisa mu □ ukaongorora kuti 8+6=14.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.prompt: Gaon akawana □ mu □+6=14 seizvi. Sarudza mutsara mumwe wakaoma kutenda.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wafungidzira kana □ ichigona kuva nhamba yakakura kupfuura 14 kana iri pasi pe14.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga mutsara wega wega wekugadzirisa nenzira uye uuenzanise nezvawakafungidzira kare.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiwo wekutanga unetsa. Kana kuwedzera 6 ku □ kwakapa 14, saka kuwedzera mamwe 6 ku14 kunopa nhamba yakakura kupfuura □. Saka □=20 mumutsara 4 yakaoma kutendawo. Zvaunoona zvinoenderana nemutsara waunosarudza. Mutsara 1 wakarurama nokuti wakashandura mutsara wenhamba kuita mashoko.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.prompt: Nyora, semashoko ekuudza Gaon, nzira yaanogona kuongorora nayo iye amene kana □=20 yakarurama.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.hint.0: Isa 20 yakawanikwa naGaon panzvimbo ye □ uye uverenge divi rekuruboshwe.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.hint.1: Isa mugumisiro wekuverenga kwako padivi pe14 kurudyi, enzanisa kana zvakafanana, uye uudze Gaon.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora nenzira kuti Gaon aiteedzere here?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora kuti kuverenga kupi kwaunoita kana ukaisa 20 here?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura kana mugumisiro wakafanana kana wakasiyana ne14 here?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.model.0: Isa 20 panzvimbo ye □ uye uverenge 20+6. I26, saka haisi 14. Saka 20 yakaipa.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.model.1: Ngatiise 20. 20+6=26, inosiyana ne14, saka yakaipa. Kana ukaisa imwe nhamba, 8, saka 8+6=14, saka yakarurama.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inoongorora nhamba isina kururama wobva waedzawo nhamba yakarurama.

z-m-01-04.title: '=' inogara ichireva kunyora mhinduro here?
z-m-01-04.goal: Wana mukugadzirisa kwakaitwa kusanzwisisika kwekuti '=' chiratidzo chekunyora mhinduro chete, uye utonge kana mitsara yenhamba iri yechokwadi kana yenhema nezvinoreva zvekuti mativi maviri ane huwandu hwakafanana.
z-m-01-04.material: Jiho akagadzirisa dambudziko rekuwana nhamba inoenda mu □ mu 3+4=□+2. Tarisa kugadzirisa kwaJiho mutsara nemutsara uye ufunge kuti '=' inoratidza chii. ('3+4' inoverengwa 'three plus four', uye '□' inoverengwa 'box'.)
z-m-01-04.thinking.2: Kuverenga divi rega rega wega nekuenzanisa
z-m-01-04.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuverenga kuri nyore nenhamba kusvika pa10
z-m-01-04.s.s1.prompt: Jiho akagadzirisa nhamba iri mu □ mu 3+4=□+2 seizvi. Sarudza mutsara mumwe wakaoma kutenda.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsara wega wega uchitaura uye uone kana unotevera zvakasikwa kubva kumutsara wakapfuura.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mumutsara wenhamba wemutsara 3, verenga divi rekuruboshwe 3+4 nedivi rekurudyi 7+2 wega uye uvaenzanise.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.line.1: Mushure me = unonyora mugumisiro wekuverenga, saka nyora 7 mu □.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiwo wekutanga unetsa. '=' haigari ichireva kuti mugumisiro unouya mushure mayo; zvinoreva kuti divi rekuruboshwe nedivi rekurudyi zvine huwandu hwakafanana. Kana ukaverenga mutsara wenhamba wemutsara 3, divi rekuruboshwe i7 uye divi rekurudyi 7+2 i9, saka hazvienzani. Saka mhedziso yemutsara 4 yakaoma kutendawo. Zvaunoona zvinoenderana nemutsara waunosarudza. Mutsara 1 wakaverengwa zvakarurama.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga 3+4=7 ne 7=3+4 imwe neimwe uchitaura uye uone kana dzose dzichiita musoro.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kana pane zvinhu 3+4 padivi rimwe rechiyero nezvinhu □+2 padivi rimwe uye chakaenzana, taura kuti ihukama hupi.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.a: Pfungwa iyi inoona '=' semuzvimbo wekunyora mhinduro chete. Zvakaoma kutsanangura mitsara yenhamba yakanyorwa sa 7=3+4.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.b: Pfungwa iyi inoona '=' sekurayira kuverenga. Haioni kuti chiratidzo chekuenzanisa kana mativi ose maviri ane huwandu hwakafanana.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.o.c: Divi rekuruboshwe nedivi rekurudyi zvine huwandu hwakafanana
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.c: Pfungwa iyi inoiona sechiratidzo chekuti mativi ose maviri ane huwandu hwakafanana.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.o.d: Nhamba iri kuruboshwe yakakura kupfuura iri kurudyi
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.d: Pfungwa iyi haigoni kusiyanisa 'zvakafanana' ne 'zvakakura'. 'Zvakakura' zvinoratidzwa nechiratidzo chakasiyana.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.explain: '=' zvinoreva kuti mativi ose maviri ane huwandu hwakafanana. Saka mu 3+4=□+2, unofanira kuita □+2 ive neshuwandu hwakafanana ne3+4.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza mitsara yose yenhamba iri pazasi iri yechokwadi.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga divi rekuruboshwe nedivi rekurudyi remutsara wega wega wenhamba wega uye uzvinyore.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kana mativi maviri akafanana, mutsara wenhamba wechokwadi. Kana asina kufanana, taura kuti divi ripi rakakura.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.a: Kunyange kana kuverenga kuri kudivi rekurudyi re '=', zvinoreva 'zvakafanana' hazvichinji.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.b: Kuruboshwe i7 uye kurudyi i8, saka hazvifanane. Izvi hazvina kuongorora kuti '=' inoreva huwandu hwakafanana.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.c: Mativi ose maviri i7. Kunyange kana pane kuverenga kumativi ose maviri, unogona kuenzanisa kana akafanana.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.d: Izvi zvingava pfungwa yakatarisa kuti nhamba iri kuruboshwe yakawedzera ne zvakadini mukuverenga kwekurudyi ndokutonga kuti zvakafanana. Unofanira kuverenga mativi ose maviri wega uye uvaenzanise.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.explain: 7=3+4 yechokwadi nokuti mativi ose maviri i7, uye 6+1=5+2 yechokwadi nokuti mativi ose maviri i7. 3+4=7+1 i7 ne8, uye 3+4=4+4 i7 ne8, saka hazvisi zvechokwadi.
